mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no AS refNo, order_name AS summary, creator_id AS applicantId, total_amount AS amount, create_time AS createTime, status FROM ad_order WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND status = #{status} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, id AS refNo, reason AS summary, create_user AS applicantId, create_time AS createTime, status FROM ad_order_change WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, contract_id AS refNo, apply_remark AS summary, applicant_id AS applicantId, create_time AS createTime, status FROM ad_seal_record WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
